structured_output.rationale: No run in this batch was accepted, so there is nothing to flag or clear. All three runs were declined, and each failed closure on its final measurement, so the report describes the batch only.
structured_output.text:
Batch: 3 runs (real movies), 0 accepted, 0 flagged, 0 cleared. r01, r02 and r03 were all declined.
What the declines have in common: every run failed closure (r01 4.66, r02 20.43, r03 4.52; threshold 1.0). Two checks that don't block acceptance were also far over their thresholds in every run. Rigid-body invariance was 3.5 to 7.3 (threshold 2.0). Plane sections was 168 to 214 (threshold 3.25). No run used the width-free ratio. No remedy was kept in the final measurement (r01 and r02 had 1 roll-back each, r03 had 2). The tracked kinematics and the tip motion don't agree in any run, so none of these profiles can be reported.
Profiles by condition (for context only, since all are declined; one root per condition):
- control (r02): centre REGR peak 31.2 %/h at 726 µm from the tip, growth zone 589 µm, largest flank difference -12.3 %/h at 84 µm.
- mannitol (r03): peak 51.0 %/h at 579 µm, growth zone 779 µm, flank difference -28.8 %/h at 547 µm. This profile has a different shape from the other two: the peak is closer to the tip and the growth zone is longer (z -2.5 and 1.7), and the flank difference is unusually large (z -4.2).
- mannitol then control (r01): peak 35.6 %/h at 695 µm, growth zone 642 µm, flank difference -9.6 %/h at 916 µm.
No conclusion about the conditions can be drawn. There is one root per condition and every measurement failed closure. The movies need re-tracking, or new movies are needed, before conditions can be compared.
